size.note: the whole 80S, with the antibiotic tigecycline bound, which is no polymer and is not measured; RACK1 (entity 70), whose name says neither subunit, stands in the small subunit, where the measure's call places it
size.says: The viewer's own measure from the entry's coordinates, by tools/measure_particle.py: each subunit as the ellipsoid of the same spread as its polymer atoms (model 1): along each of its own three axes a half-width of the square root of five times the atoms' variance; the farthest atoms beside it. The frame: origin at the centre of both subunits' atoms; y from the large subunit's centre to the small one's; x the whole particle's longest axis made square to y (the next one if the longest runs along y); z = x × y. The Protein Data Bank states no size.

surface.definition: each part as one solid: the closed surface that holds its residues' own volume (0.135 nm³ for each amino acid, 0.32 nm³ for each nucleotide), protein and nucleic acid together, in a cloud where each residue is spread as a Gaussian 2 nm wide weighted by its volume, on a grid 2 nm apart (coarser than the setting's 1.6 nm, to hold the budget); of a surface in pieces, its largest and every piece of at least 5% of its volume are kept, smaller ones dropped, each listed in the shape's file; for two tones, that solid divided where the nucleic acid's share of the cloud is the greater and where the protein's is (under tones, each inside the solid or on it)
